mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months indicates an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS decline periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 4.5%, it signals a tight labor market that may trigger inflationary concerns and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates an imminent economic contraction, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 decline > 0.5% and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and INDPRO decline > 0.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2% in 3 months) triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rise > 0.2% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.2% in 3 months and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index, 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 3 months) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 3.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 3.5% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising residential construction activity (HOUST) indicates strong housing market demand, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in HOUST rising periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals accelerating price pressures that may prompt central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.
